purpose: Audit the public Draft.js exporter documentation under /draftjs_exporter/, including anonymous documentation discovery and reading, using WSG/STAR scoped evidence.

pages.task: Understand the exporter purpose and choose the next documentation route
Find installation instructions and a complete first-render example
Understand the ContentState data model through worked examples
Configure block, style and entity output mappings
Look up API parameters and behavior in the long reference page
Compare supported rendering engines and dependencies
Find version-specific upgrade and compatibility guidance

journeys.task: An anonymous English-reading desktop visitor searches for getting started and reaches the installation command and first-render example.

contextScopes.access-barriers: Anonymous English-reading desktop Chromium visitor, 1280 × 800 CSS pixels, using keyboard text entry and pointer selection: search from the documentation homepage for getting started, reach the installation command and complete first-render example without account creation, payment or submission. Keyboard-only traversal, assistive technologies, other countries and representative-user testing are outside this task scope.
contextScopes.content-lifecycle: Public Draft.js exporter documentation under /draftjs_exporter/ as captured for this audit: assess the documented update/review lifecycle and applied compatibility guidance in the current migration guide, including retained upgrade instructions for earlier releases. Date labels alone do not establish a review schedule; repository maintenance and unpublished processes are outside scope.
contextScopes.service-necessity: The documented creation/continuation rationale for the Python Draft.js ContentState-to-HTML exporter capability, limited to the current homepage purpose statement and published alternative-engine tradeoffs. Assess whether these public records establish desirability, feasibility, viability and alternatives; do not infer unpublished business decisions or a site-wide necessity judgment.
